reason: Based on repository metadata and README, this plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness add-on that exposes a single tool to format Xiaohongshu notes, with an explicit title-length rule, so its user-facing purpose is note-formatting tooling rather than data extraction, browsing, or collaboration features.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 format_xhs_note 工具，用于按小红书规则格式化笔记文本并限制标题长度。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a format_xhs_note tool to format Xiaohongshu notes, including a title-length constraint.

capabilities: Formats Xiaohongshu note content via a DSH tool interface
Applies a title constraint using Unicode code-point length rules
Provides plugin metadata for DSH installation and injection as a tooling layer
